Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra.name: Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra
Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra.title: Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra
Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra.description: The Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra (literally "shed of 2½ days") is a historical former mosque in the city of Ajmer, in Rajasthan, India. It is one of the oldest mosques in India, and the oldest surviving monument in Ajmer.
Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra.imageCredit: Varun Shiv Kapur from New Delhi, India · CC BY 2.0

Adi Kumbeswarar Temple.name: Adi Kumbeswarar Temple
Adi Kumbeswarar Temple.title: Adi Kumbeswarar Temple, Kumbakonam
Adi Kumbeswarar Temple.description: Adi Kumbeswarar Temple, Kumbakonam is a Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva, located in the town of Kumbakonam in Thanjavur District Tamil Nadu, India. Shiva is worshiped as Adi Kumbeswarar, and is represented by the lingam.
Adi Kumbeswarar Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Adiyogi Shiva statue.name: Adiyogi Shiva statue
Adiyogi Shiva statue.title: Adiyogi Shiva bust
Adiyogi Shiva statue.description: The Adiyogi Shiva bust is a 34-metre-tall (112 ft), 45-metre-long (147 ft) and 25-metre-wide (82 ft) steel bust of Shiva with Thirunamam at Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. It is recognized by the Guinness World Records as the "Largest Bust Sculpture” in the world.
Adiyogi Shiva statue.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Agasthiyar Falls.name: Agasthiyar Falls
Agasthiyar Falls.title: Agasthiyar Falls
Agasthiyar Falls.description: Agasthiyar Falls (also called Papanasam Falls) is located close to Papanasam in Tirunelveli district in the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu. The falls is located on the Western Ghats and to the south of Papanasam lower, the lake from where Tamiraparani River originates.
Agasthiyar Falls.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Agastya Lake.name: Agastya Lake
Agastya Lake.title: Agastya Lake
Agastya Lake.description: Agastya lake, also sometimes written as Agasthya lake or referred to as Vatapi lake, is an artificial lake built c. 5th-7th century in Badami, Karnataka, South India.
Agastya Lake.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Agra Fort.name: Agra Fort
Agra Fort.title: Agra Fort
Agra Fort.description: Agra Fort (Qila Agra), also known as the Red Fort of Agra (Lal-Qila) or Qila-i-Akbari ("Akbar's Fort"), is an historic fort in the city of Agra in Uttar Pradesh, India. A brick fortification on the site, noted as early as 1080 and later known as Badalgarh, was extensively rebuilt in red sandstone by the Mughal emperor Akbar from 1565 to 1573.
Agra Fort.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Aihole.name: Aihole
Aihole.title: Aihole
Aihole.description: Aihole (ಐಹೊಳೆ), also referred to as Aivalli, Ahivolal or Aryapura, is a historic site of ancient and medieval-era Buddhist, Hindu and Jain monuments in Karnataka, India that dates from the sixth century through the twelfth century CE. Most of the surviving monuments at the site date from the 7th to 10th centuries.
Aihole.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Airavatesvara Temple.name: Airavatesvara Temple
Airavatesvara Temple.title: Airavatesvara Temple
Airavatesvara Temple.description: Airavatesvara Temple is a Hindu temple of Chola architecture located in Darasuram, a suburb of Kumbakonam, Thanjavur District in the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu. This temple, built by Chola emperor Rajaraja II in the 12th century CE is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, along with the Brihadeeswara Temple at Thanjavur, the Gangaikondacholisvaram Temple at Gangaikonda Cholapuram that are referred to as the Great Living Chola Temples.
Airavatesvara Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ajmer Sharif Dargah.name: Ajmer Sharif Dargah
Ajmer Sharif Dargah.title: Shrine of Mu'in al-Din Chishti
Ajmer Sharif Dargah.description: The Shrine of Mu'in al-Din Chishti, also known as the Ajmer Dargah Shareef, is a Sufi dargah complex incorporating the shrine of Mu'in al-Din Chishti, several tombs, and a mosque, located at Ajmer, in the state of Rajasthan, India. The shrine is significant and it is one of the most popular sites of religious visitation for Sunni Muslims in the Indian subcontinent that can attract up to 20,000 pilgrims per day, swelling to hundred of thousands on Chishti's urs.
Ajmer Sharif Dargah.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Alaknanda River.name: Alaknanda River
Alaknanda River.title: Alaknanda River
Alaknanda River.description: The Alaknanda is a Himalayan river in the Indian state of Uttarakhand and one of the two headstreams of the Ganges, the major river of Northern India and a river considered holy in Hinduism. In hydrology, the Alaknanda is considered the source stream of the Ganges on account of its greater length and discharge; while, in Hindu tradition and culture, the other headstream, the Bhagirathi, is considered the source stream.
Alaknanda River.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Alappuzha.name: Alappuzha
Alappuzha.title: Alappuzha
Alappuzha.description: Alappuzha (Malayalam: [aːlɐpːuɻɐ] ) or Alleppey is a city and municipality on the Laccadive Sea in the southern Indian state of Kerala. It is the headquarters of Alappuzha district, located about 62 km (39 mi) south of the commercial city of Kochi and 152 km (94.4 mi) northwest of the state capital Thiruvananthapuram.
Alappuzha.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Alappuzha Beach.name: Alappuzha Beach
Alappuzha Beach.title: Alappuzha Beach
Alappuzha Beach.description: Alappuzha Beach (Alleppey) is a beach in Alappuzha town and a tourist attraction in Kerala, India. Beach has an old pier which extend to sea is over 150 years old.
Alappuzha Beach.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Allahabad Fort.name: Allahabad Fort
Allahabad Fort.title: Allahabad Fort
Allahabad Fort.description: Allahabad Fort was built by the Mughal emperor Akbar at Allahabad (modern Prayagraj) in 1583. The fort stands on the banks of the Yamuna, near its confluence with the Ganges.
Allahabad Fort.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Amber Fort.name: Amber Fort
Amber Fort.title: Amber Fort
Amber Fort.description: Amer Fort or Amber Fort is a fort located in Amer, Rajasthan, India. Amer is a town with an area of 4 square kilometres (1.5 sq mi) located 11 kilometres (6.8 mi) from Jaipur, the capital of Rajasthan.
Amber Fort.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ana Sagar Lake.name: Ana Sagar Lake
Ana Sagar Lake.title: Ana Sagar Lake
Ana Sagar Lake.description: Ana Sagar Lake is an artificial lake situated in the city of Ajmer in Rajasthan state in India. It was built by Arnoraja (alias Ana), the grandfather of Prithviraj Chauhan, in 1135 -1150 AD and is named after him.
Ana Sagar Lake.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Anand Bhavan.name: Anand Bhavan
Anand Bhavan.title: Anand Bhavan
Anand Bhavan.description: Anand Bhavan (lit. 'abode of happiness') is a historic house museum in Prayagraj, India, focusing on the Nehru family.
Anand Bhavan.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Anandpur Sahib.name: Anandpur Sahib
Anandpur Sahib.title: Anandpur Sahib
Anandpur Sahib.description: Anandpur Sahib, also referred simply as Anandpur (lit. 'city of bliss'), is a city in Rupnagar district (Ropar), on the edge of Shivalik Hills, in the Indian state of Punjab.
Anandpur Sahib.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Annamalai Hill.name: Annamalai Hill
Annamalai Hill.title: Arunachala
Annamalai Hill.description: Arunachala (IAST: Aruṇācalam [əɾʊˈɳaːtʃələ], 'Red Mountain') is a hill in Tiruvannamalai district, Tamil Nadu, and one of the five main Shaiva holy places in South India. The Arunachalesvara Temple to Shiva is located at the base of the hill.
Annamalai Hill.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Arunachalesvara Temple.name: Arunachalesvara Temple
Arunachalesvara Temple.title: Arunachalesvara Temple
Arunachalesvara Temple.description: The Arunachalesvara Temple or Annamalaiyar Temple, is a Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva and Parvati, located at the foothills of the Arunachala hill in Tiruvannamalai, Tamil Nadu, India. It is regarded as one of the significant temples in the Tamil Shaivite tradition.
Arunachalesvara Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Athirappilly Falls.name: Athirappilly Falls
Athirappilly Falls.title: Athirappilly Falls
Athirappilly Falls.description: Athirappilly Falls (Malayalam: [ɐd̪iɾɐpːiɭːi]) is situated in Athirappilly  Panchayat in Chalakudy Taluk of Thrissur District in Kerala, India on the Chalakudy River, which originates from the upper reaches of the Western Ghats at the entrance to the Sholayar ranges. It is the largest waterfall in Kerala, which stands tall at 81.5 feet.
Athirappilly Falls.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Badami Cave Temples.name: Badami Cave Temples
Badami Cave Temples.title: Badami cave temples
Badami Cave Temples.description: The Badami cave temples are a complex of Buddhist, Hindu and Jain cave temples located in Badami, a town in the Bagalkot district in northern part of Karnataka, India. The caves are important examples of Indian rock-cut architecture, especially Badami Chalukya architecture, and the earliest date from the 6th century.
Badami Cave Temples.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Bahu Fort.name: Bahu Fort
Bahu Fort.title: Bahu Fort
Bahu Fort.description: The Bahu Fort is a historic fort in the city of Jammu, the winter capital of the Indian union territory of Jammu and Kashmir. Maharaja of Parmar Rajputs constructed the ancient fort on the banks on Tawi River, is believed to have been repaired by Bahu Lochan - brother of the traditional founder of Jammu, Jambu Lochan.
Bahu Fort.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Baijnath Temple.name: Baijnath Temple
Baijnath Temple.title: Baijnath Temple
Baijnath Temple.description: Baijnath Temple (Devanagari: बैजनाथ मंदिर) is a Nagara style Hindu temple situated in a small town of Baijnath located in Kangra District, Himachal Pradesh, India, and was built in 1204 AD by two local merchants named Ahuka and Manyuka. It is dedicated to Shiva as Vaidyanath (Devanagari: वैद्यनाथ),  meaning ‘the lord of physicians’.
Baijnath Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Bala Quila.name: Bala Quila
Bala Quila.title: Alwar fort
Bala Quila.description: Bala Quila also known Alwar Fort is a fort in Alwar in Indian state of Rajasthan. It is situated on a hill in the Aravalli Range, above the town of Alwar.
Bala Quila.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Bangalore Palace.name: Bangalore Palace
Bangalore Palace.title: Bengaluru Palace
Bangalore Palace.description: Bengaluru Palace is a 19th-century royal palace located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. It was commissioned by the Maharaja of Mysore, and was completed in 1874.
Bangalore Palace.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Banke Bihari Temple.name: Banke Bihari Temple
Banke Bihari Temple.title: Banke Bihari Temple
Banke Bihari Temple.description: Banke Bihari Temple is a Hindu temple situated in the town of Vrindavan, Mathura district of Uttar Pradesh, India. The temple is dedicated to Banke Bihari who is believed to be the combined form of Radha and Krishna.
Banke Bihari Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Bara Imambara.name: Bara Imambara
Bara Imambara.title: Bara Imambara
Bara Imambara.description: The Bara Imambara (Urdu: بڑا امامباڑہ), also known as the Asafi Imambara, is a significant imambara and mosque complex located in Lucknow, in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India. Built by Asaf-ud-Daula, the Nawab of Awadh, in 1784, it is the world's second largest imambara, after the Nizamat Imambara.
Bara Imambara.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health
Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health.title: Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health, Velankanni
Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health.description: The Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health, also known as Sanctuary of Our Lady of Velankanni, is a Christian shrine located at the town of Velankanni, Tamil Nadu, India. The shrine is dedicated to the Blessed Virgin Mary.
Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, P.name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, Puducherry
Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, P.title: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, Pondicherry
Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, P.description: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus (Tamil: பரிசுத்த இருதய ஆண்டவர் தேவாலயம், French: Basilique du Sacré-Cœur de Jésus de Pondichéry) is a Roman Catholic minor basilica situated on the south boulevard of Pondicherry in Puducherry, India, and is an oriental specimen of Gothic Revival architecture. It contains rare stained glass panels depicting events from the life of Christ and saints of the Catholic Church.
Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, P.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Beatles Ashram.name: Beatles Ashram
Beatles Ashram.title: Beatles Ashram
Beatles Ashram.description: Beatles Ashram (बीटल्स आश्रम), also known as Chaurasi Kutia (चौरासी कुटिया), is an ashram close to the north Indian city of Rishikesh in the state of Uttarakhand. It is located on the eastern bank of the Ganges river, opposite the Muni Ki Reti area of Rishikesh, in the foothills of the Himalayas.
Beatles Ashram.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Betaab Valley.name: Betaab Valley
Betaab Valley.title: Betaab Valley
Betaab Valley.description: Betaab Valley, also known as Hajan Valley, Hagan Valley or Hagoon, is situated at a distance of 15 km (9.3 mi) from Pahalgam in the Anantnag district in India's union territory of Jammu and Kashmir. The Valley is towards northeast of Pahalgam and falls between Pahalgam and Chandanwadi and is en route Amarnath Temple Yatra.
Betaab Valley.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Bhongir Fort.name: Bhongir Fort
Bhongir Fort.title: Bhongir Fort
Bhongir Fort.description: Bhongir Fort, also known as Bhuvanagiri Fort, is a fort located in the heart of Bhongir a town in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district, Telangana, India. It is located on a huge rock at a commanding height.
Bhongir Fort.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Bhutanatha group of temples.name: Bhutanatha group of temples
Bhutanatha group of temples.title: Bhutanatha group of temples, Badami
Bhutanatha group of temples.description: The Bhutanatha group of temples are 7th to 12th century Hindu temples to the east of Agastya lake in Badami, Karnataka state, India. It consists of two subgroups – one called the East Bhutanatha group or Bhutanatha main group from 7th to 8th century mostly in the Dravida architecture style; the other called the North Bhutanatha group or Mallikarjuna group from 11th to 12th century mostly in the Nagara architecture.
Bhutanatha group of temples.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Birla Mandir, Hyderabad.name: Birla Mandir, Hyderabad
Birla Mandir, Hyderabad.title: Birla Mandir, Hyderabad
Birla Mandir, Hyderabad.description: Birla Mandir is a Hindu temple built on a 280 feet (85 m) high hillock called Naubath Pahad  13 acres (53,000 m2) plot in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Naubat Pahad which was once also known as Band Rock so called because long ago all official communications from Mughals to the Nizams were proclaimed from this hill accompanied by music.
Birla Mandir, Hyderabad.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Brahma Sarovar.name: Brahma Sarovar
Brahma Sarovar.title: Brahma Sarovar
Brahma Sarovar.description: Brahma Sarovar (transl. Brahma's lake) is a natural and divine tank in Kurukshetra, in the state of Haryana, India.
Brahma Sarovar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Brahma Temple, Pushkar.name: Brahma Temple, Pushkar
Brahma Temple, Pushkar.title: Brahma Temple, Pushkar
Brahma Temple, Pushkar.description: Brahma Temple, Pushkar (also known as Jagatpita Brahma Mandir) is a Hindu temple situated at Pushkar in the Indian state of Rajasthan, close to the sacred Pushkar Lake to which its legend has an indelible link. The temple is one of very few existing temples dedicated to the Hindu creator-god Brahma in India and remains the most prominent among them.The temple structure dates to the 14th century CE, with later partial rebuilding.
Brahma Temple, Pushkar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Brihadisvara Temple.title: Brihadisvara Temple
Brihadisvara Temple.description: Brihadisvara Temple, called Rajarajesvaram (lit. 'Lord of Rajaraja') by its builder, and known locally as Thanjai Periya Kovil (lit.

Brindavan Gardens.name: Brindavan Gardens
Brindavan Gardens.title: Brindavan Gardens
Brindavan Gardens.description: The Brindavan Gardens is a garden located 12 k.ms from the city of Mysore in the Mandya District of the Indian State of Karnataka. It lies adjoining the Krishnarajasagara Dam which is built across the river Kaveri.
Brindavan Gardens.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Buland Darwaza.name: Buland Darwaza
Buland Darwaza.title: Buland Darwaza
Buland Darwaza.description: Buland Darwaza (lit. 'Exalted Gate'), or the "Door of victory", is a gateway whose construction was started in 1573 by Mughal emperor Akbar to commemorate his victory over Gujarat.
Buland Darwaza.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Chamundeshwari Temple.name: Chamundeshwari Temple
Chamundeshwari Temple.title: Chamundeshwari Temple
Chamundeshwari Temple.description: The Chamundeshwari Temple is a Hindu temple located on the top of Chamundi Hills about 13 km from the palace city of Mysuru in the state of Karnataka in India. The temple was named after Chamundeshwari or, the fierce form of Shakti, a tutelary deity held in reverence for centuries by the Maharaja of Mysuru.
Chamundeshwari Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar.name: Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar
Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar.title: Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar
Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar.description: Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar (Hindi: चण्डी देवी मंदिर, हरिद्वार) is a Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Chandi Devi in the holy city of Haridwar in the Uttarakhand state of India. The temple is situated atop the Neel Parvat on the Eastern summit of the Sivalik Hills, the southernmost mountain chain of the Himalayas.
Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Charminar.name: Charminar
Charminar.title: Charminar
Charminar.description: The Charminar (lit. 'four minarets') is a monument located in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
Charminar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Chaukhandi Stupa.name: Chaukhandi Stupa
Chaukhandi Stupa.title: Chaukhandi Stupa
Chaukhandi Stupa.description: Chaukhandi Stupa is a Buddhist stupa  in Sarnath located 8 kilometres from Cantt Railway Station in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. The site was declared to be a monument of national importance by the Archaeological Survey of India in June 2019.
Chaukhandi Stupa.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple.name: Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple
Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple.title: Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple
Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple.description: Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple, also known as Selva Pillai or Thirunarayanapuram,  is a temple in Melukote in the Mandya District of Karnataka, India. The temple lies on the foothills of Melkote and is associated with the Yoga Narasimha temple built on rocky hills which overlook the Kaveri valley.
Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Chettinad.name: Chettinad
Chettinad.title: Chettinad
Chettinad.description: Chettinad  (also known as Chettinadu) is a region in Tamil Nadu comprising 56 villages in Sivaganga district and 20 villages in Pudukottai district, which was historically ruled by the Ramnad kingdom of Pandya Nadu. It has a small portion extending into the Pudukottai District in Tamil Nadu; Karaikudi is the major city of this area and is considered the urban centre for the Chettinadu villages.
Chettinad.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Chittorgarh Fort.name: Chittorgarh Fort
Chittorgarh Fort.title: Chittor Fort
Chittorgarh Fort.description: Chittor Fort (the literal translation of the Hindi Chittorgarh), also known as Chittod Fort, is one of the largest forts in India. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Chittorgarh Fort.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Chota Imambara.name: Chota Imambara
Chota Imambara.title: Chota Imambara
Chota Imambara.description: Imambara Hussainabad Mubarak, popularly known as Chhota Imambara, is a monument located in the city of Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. It took 54 years to build.
Chota Imambara.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Christ Church, Shimla.name: Christ Church, Shimla
Christ Church, Shimla.title: Christ Church, Shimla
Christ Church, Shimla.description: Christ Church, Shimla, is the second oldest church in North India, after St John's Church in Meerut. Worship is conducted in Hindi and English.
Christ Church, Shimla.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

City Palace, Udaipur.name: City Palace, Udaipur
City Palace, Udaipur.title: City Palace, Udaipur
City Palace, Udaipur.description: City Palace (Raj Mahal), Udaipur is a palace complex situated in the city of Udaipur in the Indian state of Rajasthan. It was built over a period of nearly 400 years, with contributions from several rulers of the Mewar dynasty.
City Palace, Udaipur.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Courtallam.name: Courtallam
Courtallam.title: Courtallam
Courtallam.description: Rajah Courtallam, natively spelt Kutrālam or Kuttālam, is a panchayat town situated at a mean elevation of 160 m (520 ft) in the foothills of the Western Ghats in Tenkasi district of Tamil Nadu, India. The Coutrallam Falls on the Chittar River is a major tourist attraction.
Courtallam.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Courtallam.imageCredit: Mdsuhail at English Wikipedia · CC BY-SA 3.0

Dal Lake.name: Dal Lake
Dal Lake.title: Dal Lake
Dal Lake.description: Dal (Urdu pronunciation: [ɖəl] ; Kashmiri pronunciation: [ɖal]) is a freshwater lake in Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir in Indian-administered Kashmir. It is an urban lake, the second largest lake in Jammu and Kashmir, and the most visited place in Srinagar by tourists and locals.
Dal Lake.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Dashashwamedh Ghat.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
Dashashwamedh Ghat.title: Dashashwamedh Ghat
Dashashwamedh Ghat.description: Dashashwamedh Ghat is a main ghat in Varanasi located on the Ganges River in Uttar Pradesh, India. It is located close to Vishwanath Temple.
Dashashwamedh Ghat.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Descent of the Ganges (Mahabalipuram).name: Descent of the Ganges (Mahabalipuram)
Descent of the Ganges (Mahabalipuram).title: Descent of the Ganges (Mahabalipuram)
Descent of the Ganges (Mahabalipuram).description: Descent of the Ganges, known locally as Arjuna's Penance, is a monument at Mamallapuram, on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal, in the Chengalpattu district of the state of Tamil Nadu, India. Measuring 96 by 43 feet (29 m × 13 m),  it is a giant open-air rock relief carved on two monolithic rock boulders.
Descent of the Ganges (Mahabalipuram).visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Devprayag.name: Devprayag
Devprayag.title: Devprayag
Devprayag.description: Devprayag  (Deva prayāga) is a town and a nagar palika, near New Tehri city in Tehri Garhwal District in the state of Uttarakhand, India, and is the final one of the Panch Prayag (five confluences) of Alaknanda River where Alaknanda meets the Bhagirathi river and both rivers thereafter flow on as the Ganges river or Ganga.
Devprayag.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Dhamek Stupa.name: Dhamek Stupa

Kulasekarapattinam.title: Kulasekarapattinam

Historically, it was an important port on the Coromandel Coast, alongside Kaveripumpattinam (Poompuhar) and Arikamedu (near Pondicherry).
Kulasekarapattinam.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kullu.name: Kullu
Kullu.title: Kullu
Kullu.description: Kullu (Hindi: [kʊlːuː]) is a municipal council town that serves as the administrative headquarters of the Kullu district of the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. It is located on the banks of the Beas River in the Kullu Valley about 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) north of the airport at Bhuntar, Kullu.
Kullu.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kumarakom.name: Kumarakom
Kumarakom.title: Kumarakom
Kumarakom.description: Kumarakom is a tourism destination near the city of Kottayam in Kerala, India. It is near the Vembanad Lake, the largest lake in the state of Kerala.
Kumarakom.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary.name: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary.title: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary.description: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary (also known as Vembanad Bird Sanctuary) is situated at Kumarakom in Kottayam taluk of Kottayam district in the Indian state of Kerala, on the banks of Vembanad Lake. Set in the Kerala Backwaters, the bird sanctuary is visited by many migratory bird species.
Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kumbhalgarh Fort.name: Kumbhalgarh Fort
Kumbhalgarh Fort.title: Kumbhalgarh
Kumbhalgarh Fort.description: Kumbhalgarh also known as the Great Wall of India, is a fortress located on the western range of the Aravalli Hills in Kumbhalgarh, Rajsamand district, Rajasthan, India. Located approximately 48 km (30 mi) from Rajsamand and 84 km (52 mi) from Udaipur, the fort was constructed in the 15th century by Rana Kumbha.
Kumbhalgarh Fort.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary.name: Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary
Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary.title: Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary
Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary.description: Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary is located in the Rajsamand District of Rajasthan State in western India. It surrounds the Kumbhalgarh Fortress and covers an area of 610.528 km2 (236 sq mi).
Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Kurukshetra Panorama and Science Centre.name: Kurukshetra Panorama and Science Centre
Kurukshetra Panorama and Science Centre.title: Kurukshetra Panorama and Science Centre
Kurukshetra Panorama and Science Centre.description: The Kurukshetra Panorama and Science Centre is located next to Shrikrishna Museum in Thanesar, Kurukshetra, Haryana, India about 1.5 km from Kurukshetra railway station.
Kurukshetra Panorama and Science Centre.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Lake Pichola.name: Lake Pichola
Lake Pichola.title: Lake Pichola
Lake Pichola.description: Lake Pichola, in Udaipur city in the Indian state of Rajasthan, is an artificial freshwater lake, created in the year 1362, named after the nearby Picholi village. It is one of the several contiguous lakes, and developed over the last few centuries in and around Udaipur city.
Lake Pichola.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Lalbagh Botanical Garden.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
Lalbagh Botanical Garden.title: Lal Bagh
Lalbagh Botanical Garden.description: Lalbagh Botanical Garden or simply Lalbagh (lit. 'red garden'), is a botanical garden in Bengaluru, India.
Lalbagh Botanical Garden.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Lidder River.name: Lidder River
Lidder River.title: Lidder River
Lidder River.description: The Lidder or Liddar (IPA: /lʲədɨr/) is a 73 km (45 mi) river situated in the Kashmir Valley of Jammu and Kashmir, India. It originates from the Kolahoi Glacier and feeds the Jhelum River in Mirgund Khanabal, at an altitude of 1,615 metres (5,299 ft).
Lidder River.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Lotus Mahal.name: Lotus Mahal
Lotus Mahal.title: Lotus Mahal
Lotus Mahal.description: Lotus Mahal or Chitrangini Mahal is an important secular structure in Hampi, India. The Lotus Mahal is an example of Vijayanagara style of architecture and is a two storied structure built in Rubble masonry and finely plastered.
Lotus Mahal.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna.name: Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna
Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna.title: Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna
Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna.description: The Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna is a 4th-century-CE Hindu temple in Gokarna, Uttara Kannada district, Karnataka state, India, built in the classical Dravidian architectural style. It is a site of religious pilgrimage.
Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mahavira Jain temple, Osian.name: Mahavira Jain temple, Osian
Mahavira Jain temple, Osian.title: Mahavira Jain temple, Osian
Mahavira Jain temple, Osian.description: The Mahavira Jain temple is built in Osian of Jodhpur District, Rajasthan. The temple is an important pilgrimage of the Oswal Jain community.
Mahavira Jain temple, Osian.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Malpe Beach.name: Malpe Beach
Malpe Beach.title: Malpe
Malpe Beach.description: Malpe is a natural port in the Udupi District in Karnataka, India. Located at the mouth of the Malpe River about six kilometers to the west of Udupi, it is an important port and a major fishing harbor on the Karnataka coast.
Malpe Beach.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mangala Devi Kannagi Temple.name: Mangala Devi Kannagi Temple
Mangala Devi Kannagi Temple.title: Mangala Devi Kannagi Temple
Mangala Devi Kannagi Temple.description: Mangaladevi Kannagi Temple is a Hindu temple located at Mangaladevi, near the present-day border of Theni District (of Tamil Nadu) and Idukki District (Kerala), about 7 km from Pazhiyankudi in Theni District and 15 km from Thekkady in Idukki District. The temple is situated at an altitude of about 1,337 m or about 5,000 feet above sea level (within the Periyar Tiger Reserve on the Western Ghat mountains).
Mangala Devi Kannagi Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Manikarnika Ghat.name: Manikarnika Ghat
Manikarnika Ghat.title: Manikarnika Ghat
Manikarnika Ghat.description: Manikarnika Ghat (Hindi: मणिकर्णिका घाट) is one of the oldest and sacred ghats on the banks of the River Ganges, in the city of Varanasi in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is included in the 84 ghats of Varanasi.
Manikarnika Ghat.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Manikarnika Ghat.imageCredit: Aleksandr Zykov from Russia · CC BY-SA 2.0

Manimuthar Dam.name: Manimuthar Dam
Manimuthar Dam.title: Manimuthar Dam
Manimuthar Dam.description: The Manimuthar Dam is located in Manimutharu 50.8 kilometres (31.6 mi) away from Tirunelveli in Tamil Nadu, India. It is the biggest reservoir of the Tirunelveli district.
Manimuthar Dam.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar.name: Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar
Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar.title: Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar
Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar.description: Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar (Hindi: मंसा देवी मंदिर, हरिद्वार) is a Hindu temple dedicated to goddess Mansa Devi in the holy city of Haridwar in the Uttarakhand state of India. The temple is located atop the Bilwa Parvat on the Sivalik Hills, the southernmost mountain chain of the Himalayas.
Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mattancherry Palace.name: Mattancherry Palace
Mattancherry Palace.title: Mattancherry Palace
Mattancherry Palace.description: The Mattancherry Palace is a palace popularly known as the Dutch Palace, in Mattancherry, Kochi, in the Indian state of Kerala which features Kerala murals depicting portraits and exhibits of the Rajas of Kochi. The palace was included in the tentative list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
Mattancherry Palace.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mattupetty Dam.name: Mattupetty Dam
Mattupetty Dam.title: Mattupetty Dam
Mattupetty Dam.description: Mattupetty Dam (Madupetty Dam), Kannan Devan Hills in Idukki District,  is a  storage concrete gravity dam built  in  the mountains of Kerala, India, to conserve water for hydroelectricity. It has been a vital source of power and huge revenue for Idukki District.
Mattupetty Dam.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mayuranathaswami Temple.name: Mayuranathaswami Temple
Mayuranathaswami Temple.title: Mayuranathaswami Temple, Mayiladuthurai
Mayuranathaswami Temple.description: Mayuranathaswamy Temple, also known as  Mayuranathar Temple or Tirumayiladuthurai, is a Hindu temple in the town of Mayiladuthurai (formerly known as Mayavaram or Mayuram) in Tamil Nadu, India. The temple is dedicated to Lord Mayuranathaswamy, a form of Shiva, and has given its name to the town itself.
Mayuranathaswami Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Meenakshi Temple.name: Meenakshi Temple
Meenakshi Temple.title: Meenakshi Temple
Meenakshi Temple.description: Meenakshi Temple, also known as Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple, is a historic Hindu temple located on the southern bank of the Vaigai River in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India. It is dedicated to Meenakshi, a form of Parvati, and her consort Sundareswarar (Shiva).
Meenakshi Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mehrangarh Fort.name: Mehrangarh Fort
Mehrangarh Fort.title: Mehrangarh
Mehrangarh Fort.description: Mehrangarh is a historic fort located in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India. It stands on a hilltop, rising about 122 m (400 ft) above the surrounding plains, and the complex spans 1,200 acres (486 hectares).
Mehrangarh Fort.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Melukote.name: Melukote
Melukote.title: Melukote
Melukote.description: Melukote in Pandavapura taluk of Mandya district, Karnataka, in southern India, is one of the sacred places in Karnataka. It is built on rocky hills, known as Yadugiri, Yaadavagiri or Yadushaila, overlooking the Cauvery valley.
Melukote.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mettur Dam.name: Mettur Dam
Mettur Dam.title: Mettur Dam
Mettur Dam.description: The Mettur Dam is one of the largest dams in India, built during colonial rule, and the largest in Tamil Nadu, located across the river Kaveri where it enters the plains. Built in 1934, it took nine years to complete.
Mettur Dam.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Mettur Dam.imageCredit: The original uploader was Vvenka1 at English Wikipedia. · CC BY-SA 2.5

Mindrolling Monastery.name: Mindrolling Monastery
Mindrolling Monastery.title: Mindrolling Monastery
Mindrolling Monastery.description: Mindrolling Monastery (Tibetan: སྨིན་གྲོལ་གླིང་དགོན་པ་, Wylie: min-dröl-ling gön-pa, THL: smin-grol-gling dgon-pa, English: "Sublime Island of Ripening Liberation") is one of the "Six Mother Monasteries" of the Nyingma school in Tibet. It was founded by Rigzin Terdak Lingpa in 1676.
Mindrolling Monastery.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Murudeshwar.name: Murudeshwar
Murudeshwar.title: Murdeshwar
Murudeshwar.description: Murdeshwar or Murudeshwara is a town in Uttara Kannada district in the state of Karnataka, India, and lies on the coast of the Arabian Sea. It contains the world's third tallest Shiva statue, as well as the Murudeshwara Temple.
Murudeshwar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Mysore Palace.name: Mysore Palace
Mysore Palace.title: Mysore Palace
Mysore Palace.description: Mysore Palace, also known as Amba Vilas Palace, is a historic palace and royal residence located in Mysore, Karnataka, India. It served as the official residence of the Wadiyar dynasty and the seat of the Kingdom of Mysore, and was commissioned by Krishnaraja Wodeyar IV in August 1897 following the destruction of the previous structure in a fire.
Mysore Palace.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Nagaraja Temple, Nagercoil.name: Nagaraja Temple, Nagercoil
Nagaraja Temple, Nagercoil.title: Nagaraja Temple, Nagercoil
Nagaraja Temple, Nagercoil.description: Nagaraja Temple is an early large temple found in the city of Nagercoil (Nagarkōyil) near the southern tip of Tamil Nadu, India. Its dating is uncertain but likely pre-12th-century.
Nagaraja Temple, Nagercoil.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Nagaraja Temple, Nagercoil.imageCredit: Infocaster at English Wikipedia · CC BY-SA 3.0

Naggar Castle.name: Naggar Castle
Naggar Castle.title: Naggar Castle
Naggar Castle.description: Naggar Castle is a medieval castle, located in Kullu, Himachal Pradesh, India. It was built by Raja Sidh Singh of Kullu around 1460 AD, it was taken over by the Himachal Pradesh Tourism Development Corporation (HPTDC), to run as a heritage hotel, in 1978.
Naggar Castle.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Nagore Dargah.name: Nagore Dargah
Nagore Dargah.title: Nagore Dargah
Nagore Dargah.description: The Nagore Dargah, also known as the Nagore Dargah Shareef, the Syed Shahul Hamid Dargah, or the Nagore Andavar Dargah, is a dargah complex built over the tomb of the Sufi saint Nagore Syed Abdul Qadir Shahul Hamid, located in Nagore, a coastal town in the Nagapattinam district of the state of Tamil Nadu, India. Shahul Hamid is believed to have performed many miracles in Nagore, and cured the physical affliction of king Achuthappa Nayak, a 16th-century Hindu ruler of Thanjavur.
Nagore Dargah.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Namakkal Anjaneyar Temple.name: Namakkal Anjaneyar Temple
Namakkal Anjaneyar Temple.title: Namakkal Anjaneyar Temple
Namakkal Anjaneyar Temple.description: Namakkal Anjaneyar temple is located in Namakkal, a town in Namakkal district in Tamil Nadu, India and is dedicated to the Hindu god Hanuman. It is constructed in the Tamil style of architecture.
Namakkal Anjaneyar Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Namakkal Fort.name: Namakkal Fort
Namakkal Fort.title: Namakkal Fort
Namakkal Fort.description: Namakkal Fort is a historic fort present in Namakkal in Namakkal district in the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu. The fort was built during the reign of Thirumalai Nayak of Madurai in 17th century.
Namakkal Fort.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Namgyal Monastery.name: Namgyal Monastery
Namgyal Monastery.title: Namgyal Monastery
Namgyal Monastery.description: Namgyal Monastery (Tibetan: རྣམ་རྒྱལ།, Wylie: rnam rgyal) (also often referred to as "Dalai Lama's Temple") is located in Mcleod Ganj, Dharamsala, India. It is the personal monastery of the 14th Dalai Lama.
Namgyal Monastery.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Namgyal Monastery.imageCredit: (in search for a new country of residence) · CC BY-SA 2.0

Napier Museum.name: Napier Museum
Napier Museum.title: Napier Museum
Napier Museum.description: The Napier Museum is an art and natural history museum situated in Thiruvananthapuram, India. The museum grounds are home to the Thiruvananthapuram Zoo, one of the oldest zoological gardens in India.
Napier Museum.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Nataraja Temple, Chidambaram.name: Nataraja Temple, Chidambaram
Nataraja Temple, Chidambaram.title: Nataraja Temple, Chidambaram
Nataraja Temple, Chidambaram.description: Thillai Nataraja Temple, also referred as the Chidambaram Nataraja Temple, is a Hindu temple dedicated to Nataraja, the form of Shiva as the lord of dance (cosmic dancer). This temple is located in Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu, India.
Nataraja Temple, Chidambaram.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Nataraja Temple, Chidambaram.imageCredit: Jean-Pierre Dalbéra from Paris, France · CC BY 2.0

Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary.name: Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary
Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary.title: Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary
Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary.description: Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary is a bird sanctuary in Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, India, near the village of Nelapattu. It has an area of 458.92 hectares.
Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Nellaiappar Temple.name: Nellaiappar Temple
Nellaiappar Temple.title: Nellaiappar Temple
Nellaiappar Temple.description: The Nellaiappar Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to the deity Shiva, located in Tirunelveli, a city in the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu. Shiva is worshipped as Nellaiappar (also called Venuvananathar) represented by the lingam and his consort Parvati is depicted as Kanthimathi Amman.
Nellaiappar Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Netrani Island.name: Netrani Island
Netrani Island.title: Netrani Island
Netrani Island.description: Netrani (historically known as Bajrangi Island, Pigeon Island and also Heart Shaped Island) is a small island of India located in the Arabian Sea. It is the only heart island which is present in India.
Netrani Island.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Nilgiri Mountain Railway.name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway
Nilgiri Mountain Railway.title: Nilgiri Mountain Railway
Nilgiri Mountain Railway.description: The Nilgiri Mountain Railway (NMR), colloquially called the "Toy Train" by locals, is a 1,000 mm (3 ft 3+3⁄8 in) metre gauge railway in Nilgiris district, Tamil Nadu, India, built by the British in 1908. The railway is operated by the Southern Railway and is the only rack railway in India.
Nilgiri Mountain Railway.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Nilgiri Mountain Railway.imageCredit: A.M.Hurrell (photo)No machine-readable author provided. AHEMSLTD~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims). · CC BY 2.5

Nishat Bagh.name: Nishat Bagh
Nishat Bagh.title: Nishat Bagh
Nishat Bagh.description: Nishat Bagh (lit. 'Garden of Joy' or 'Garden of Delight') is a terraced Mughal garden built on the eastern bank of the Dal Lake, close to Srinagar in the Indian-administered union territory of Jammu and Kashmir in the disputed Kashmir region.
Nishat Bagh.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ooty Lake.name: Ooty Lake
Ooty Lake.title: Ooty Lake
Ooty Lake.description: Ooty lake is an artificial lake near Ooty in the Nilgiris district of Tamil Nadu, India. It covers an area of 26 hectares (64 acres).
Ooty Lake.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Padmanabhapuram Palace.name: Padmanabhapuram Palace
Padmanabhapuram Palace.title: Padmanabhapuram Palace
Padmanabhapuram Palace.description: Padmanabhapuram Palace, also known as Kalkulam Palace, is a Travancore-era palace located in Padmanabhapuram in the Kanyakumari district of the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. The palace is owned, controlled and maintained by the Kerala Government.
Padmanabhapuram Palace.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Padmanabhaswamy Temple.name: Padmanabhaswamy Temple
Padmanabhaswamy Temple.title: Padmanabhaswamy Temple
Padmanabhaswamy Temple.description: The Padmanabhaswamy Temple (Malayalam: [pɐd̪mɐnaːbʰɐswaːmi]) is a Hindu temple dedicated to Vishnu in Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam, India. It is one of the 108 Divya Desams which are considered the sacred sites of the Sri Vaishnava tradition.
Padmanabhaswamy Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Pahalgam.name: Pahalgam
Pahalgam.title: Pahalgam
Pahalgam.description: Pahalgam (Urdu pronunciation: [pɛɦɛlɡɑːm]) or Pahalgom (Kashmiri pronunciation: [pəhəlʲɡoːm]) is a town in Anantnag district of the Indian union territory of Jammu and Kashmir. It is located on the banks of Lidder River at an altitude of 2,200 m (7,200 ft) in the Vale of Kashmir.
Pahalgam.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Palampur, Himachal Pradesh.name: Palampur, Himachal Pradesh
Palampur, Himachal Pradesh.title: Palampur, Himachal Pradesh
Palampur, Himachal Pradesh.description: Palampur is a hill station and a municipal corporation situated in the Kangra District in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. Palampur is served by the Palampur Himachal railway station (PLMX), situated in Maranda.
Palampur, Himachal Pradesh.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.
Palampur, Himachal Pradesh.imageCredit: Sumeet Jain from San Francisco, USA · CC BY-SA 2.0

Palani Hills.name: Palani Hills
Palani Hills.title: Palani Hills
Palani Hills.description: The Palani Hills are a mountain range in the southern Indian states of Tamil Nadu and Kerala. The Palani Hills are an eastward extension of the Western Ghats ranges, which run parallel to the west coast of India.
Palani Hills.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Pamban Bridge.name: Pamban Bridge
Pamban Bridge.title: Pamban Bridge
Pamban Bridge.description: Pamban Bridge (Tamil: [paːmbɐn], romanised: pāmban) was a railway bridge that connected the town of Rameswaram on Pamban Island with Mandapam in mainland India. Opened on 24 February 1914, it was India's first sea bridge, and was the longest sea bridge in India until the opening of the Bandra–Worli Sea Link in 2010.
Pamban Bridge.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Panambur Beach.name: Panambur Beach
Panambur Beach.title: Panambur Beach
Panambur Beach.description: Panambur Beach is a beach on the shores of the Arabian Sea in the city of Mangaluru in the Indian state of Karnataka. It is the most visited beach in Mangalore city (now, Mangaluru).
Panambur Beach.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Panch Mahal, Fatehpur Sikri.name: Panch Mahal, Fatehpur Sikri
Panch Mahal, Fatehpur Sikri.title: Panch Mahal, Fatehpur Sikri
Panch Mahal, Fatehpur Sikri.description: Panch Mahal is a palace in Fatehpur Sikri, Uttar Pradesh, India. The Panch Mahal meaning 'Five level Palace' was commissioned by Akbar.
Panch Mahal, Fatehpur Sikri.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Pancha Rathas.name: Pancha Rathas
Pancha Rathas.title: Pancha Rathas
Pancha Rathas.description: Pancha Rathas (also known as Five Rathas or Pandava Rathas or Ainthinai kovil) is a monument complex at Mahabalipuram, on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal, in the Chengalpattu district of the state of Tamil Nadu, India. Pancha Rathas is an example of monolithic Indian rock-cut architecture.
Pancha Rathas.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Paradesi Synagogue.name: Paradesi Synagogue
Paradesi Synagogue.title: Paradesi Synagogue
Paradesi Synagogue.description: The Paradesi Synagogue or the Mattancherry Synagogue is a synagogue located in Mattancherry Jew Town, a suburb of the city of Kochi, Kerala, in India. It was built in 1568 A.D.
Paradesi Synagogue.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Partition Museum.name: Partition Museum
Partition Museum.title: Partition Museum
Partition Museum.description: The Partition Museum is a public museum located in the town hall of Amritsar, Punjab, India. The museum aims to become the central repository of stories, materials, and documents related to the post-partition riots that followed the division of British India into two independent dominions: India and Pakistan.
Partition Museum.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Patnitop.name: Patnitop
Patnitop.title: Patnitop
Patnitop.description: Patnitop is a hill station, located, between Ramban Town and Udhampur city in the Udhampur district of Jammu and Kashmir, India. It is in located on the Jammu-Srinagar National Highway (which is part of National Highway 44, formerly 1A), 112 km (70 mi) from Jammu, on the way from Udhampur to Srinagar.
Patnitop.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Pattadakal.name: Pattadakal
Pattadakal.title: Pattadakal
Pattadakal.description: Pattadakal (Pattadakallu), also called Raktapura, is a complex of 7th and 8th century CE Hindu and Jain temples in northern Karnataka, India. Located on the west bank of the Malaprabha River in Bagalkot district, this UNESCO World Heritage Site is 23 kilometres (14 mi) from Badami and about 9.7 kilometres (6 mi) from Aihole, both of which are historically significant centres of Chalukya monuments.
Pattadakal.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Periyar Lake.name: Periyar Lake
Periyar Lake.title: Periyar River
Periyar Lake.description: The Periyar (Malayalam: [peɾijaːr], meaning: big river) is the longest river and has the largest discharge potential in the Indian state of Kerala. It is one of the few perennial rivers in the region and provides drinking water for several major towns.

Perur Pateeswarar Temple.name: Perur Pateeswarar Temple
Perur Pateeswarar Temple.title: Perur Pateeswarar Temple, Coimbatore
Perur Pateeswarar Temple.description: Perur Pateeswarar Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva located at Perur, in western part of Coimbatore in state of Tamil Nadu in India. The temple was built by Karikala Chola in 2nd century CE.
Perur Pateeswarar Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Pichavaram.name: Pichavaram
Pichavaram.title: Pichavaram
Pichavaram.description: Pichavaram is one of the villages of Parangipettai near Chidambaram in Cuddalore District, Tamil Nadu, India. It is located between the Vellar estuary in the north and Coleroon estuary in the south.
Pichavaram.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Prem Mandir, Vrindavan.name: Prem Mandir, Vrindavan
Prem Mandir, Vrindavan.title: Prem Mandir, Vrindavan
Prem Mandir, Vrindavan.description: Prem Mandir is a Hindu temple in Vrindavan, Mathura district, Western Uttar Pradesh, India. The temple was established by Kripalu Maharaj.
Prem Mandir, Vrindavan.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Promenade Beach.name: Promenade Beach
Promenade Beach.title: Promenade Beach
Promenade Beach.description: Rock Beach (or, known as, "Promenade Beach", French: Plage de la Promenade)  is the popular stretch of beachfront in the city of Puducherry, India, along the Bay of Bengal. It is a 1.2-kilometre-long stretch in Pondicherry, starts from War Memorial and end at Dupleix Park on the Goubert Avenue.

Pulicat Lake.name: Pulicat Lake
Pulicat Lake.title: Pulicat Lake
Pulicat Lake.description: Pulicat Lake is the second-largest brackish-water lagoon in India (after Chilika Lake), measuring 759 square kilometres (293 sq mi). A major part of the lagoon lies in the Tirupati district of Andhra Pradesh and rest with Thiruvallur district of Tamil Nadu.

Punnathur Kotta.name: Punnathur Kotta
Punnathur Kotta.title: Punnathurkotta
Punnathur Kotta.description: Punnathurkotta  is a fort and former palace located in Kottapadi, about 3 km  from the Guruvayoor Sree Krishna Temple, in Thrissur District of Kerala State in South India.
Punnathur Kotta.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Pushkar Lake.name: Pushkar Lake
Pushkar Lake.title: Pushkar Lake
Pushkar Lake.description: Pushkar Lake or Pushkar Sarovar is located in the town of Pushkar near Ajmer city in Ajmer district of the Rajasthan state of western India. Pushkar Lake is a sacred lake for the Hindus.

Qutb Minar.name: Qutb Minar
Qutb Minar.title: Qutb Minar
Qutb Minar.description: The Qutb Minar, also spelled Qutub Minar and Qutab Minar, is a minaret and victory tower, built during the Delhi sultanate, and comprising the Qutb complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Mehrauli, South Delhi, India. It was mostly built between 1199 and 1220, contains 399 steps, and is one of the most frequented heritage spots in the city.
Qutb Minar.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Raghunath Temple, Jammu.name: Raghunath Temple, Jammu
Raghunath Temple, Jammu.title: Raghunath Temple

Raghunathji Temple, Devprayag.name: Raghunathji Temple, Devprayag
Raghunathji Temple, Devprayag.title: Raghunath Temple, Devprayag
Raghunathji Temple, Devprayag.description: Raghunathji Temple (also called Tirukantamenum Kadi Nagar) in Devprayag, a pilgrimage town in Tehri Garhwal district in Himalayas in the North Indian state of Uttarakhand, is dedicated to Vishnu. Raghunathji Temple, Devprayag.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ram Jhula.name: Ram Jhula
Ram Jhula.title: Ram Jhula
Ram Jhula.description: Ram Jhula  (Hindi: राम झूला) is an iron suspension bridge across the river Ganges, located 3 kilometres (1.9 mi) north-east from the center of the city of  Rishikesh in the Indian state of Uttarakhand. The bridge connects the Sivananda Nagar area of Muni Ki Reti in the Tehri Garhwal district to the Swargashram area of Rishikesh in the Pauri Garhwal district, crossing the river from west to east.
Ram Jhula.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ram Mandir.name: Ram Mandir
Ram Mandir.title: Ram Mandir
Ram Mandir.description: The Ram Mandir (ISO: Rāma Maṁdira, lit. 'Rama Temple'), is a Hindu temple complex in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, India.
Ram Mandir.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ramanathaswamy Temple.name: Ramanathaswamy Temple
Ramanathaswamy Temple.title: Ramanathaswamy Temple
Ramanathaswamy Temple.description: Ramanathaswamy Temple (Rāmanātasvāmi Kōyil) is a Hindu temple dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva located on Rameswaram island in the state of Tamil Nadu, India. It is one of the twelve Jyotirlinga temples.
Ramanathaswamy Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ramappa Temple.name: Ramappa Temple
Ramappa Temple.title: Ramappa Temple
Ramappa Temple.description: The Rudreshwara Temple, more commonly known as the Ramappa Temple, is a Hindu temple located in the village of Palampet in eastern Telangana, India. An inscription on a basalt pillar found within a nearby courtyard records that the temple was commissioned in 1213 by Recherla Rudra, a military general of the Kakatiya dynasty, and constructed over a period of 40 years during the reign of Ganapatideva, the third sovereign of the dynasty.

Ranakpur Jain temple.name: Ranakpur Jain temple
Ranakpur Jain temple.title: Ranakpur Jain temple
Ranakpur Jain temple.description: Ranakpur Jain temple or Chaturmukha Dharana Vihara is a Śvētāmbara Jain temple at Ranakpur dedicated to Tirthankara Rishabhanatha. The temple is located in the village of Ranakpur near Sadri in the Pali district of Rajasthan.

Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangam.name: Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangam
Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangam.title: Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangam
Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangam.description: The Ranganathaswamy Temple, also known as Arulmigu Ranganathar Thirukovil, is a Hindu temple dedicated to Ranganathar (a form of Vishnu) and his consort Ranganayaki (a form of Lakshmi). The temple is located in Srirangam, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, India.
Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangam.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangapatna.name: Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangapatna
Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangapatna.title: Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangapatna
Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangapatna.description: The Ranganathaswamy temple or Sri Ranganathaswamy temple in Srirangapatna, in the Mandya district of Karnataka state, India, is dedicated to the Hindu god Ranganatha (a manifestation of Vishnu). The temple is classified one among the 108 Abhimana Kshethram of Vaishnavate tradition.
Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangapatna.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Red Fort.name: Red Fort
Red Fort.title: Red Fort
Red Fort.description: The Red Fort (Lal Qila in Hindi; Hindi pronunciation: [laːl 'qɪlaː]) is a historic Mughal fort located in the Old Delhi area of Delhi, India. Serving as the main residence of the Mughal emperors, it was commissioned by Emperor Shah Jahan on the 12th of May 1639; the fort was constructed following his decision to shift the Mughal capital from Agra to Delhi.
Red Fort.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Rock Garden of Chandigarh.name: Rock Garden of Chandigarh
Rock Garden of Chandigarh.title: Rock Garden of Chandigarh
Rock Garden of Chandigarh.description: The Rock Garden of Chandigarh is a sculpture garden in Chandigarh, India. It is also known as Nek Chand Saini's Rock Garden of Nathupur  after its founder Nek Chand Saini, a government official who started building the garden secretly in his spare time in 1957.
Rock Garden of Chandigarh.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Rumi Darwaza.name: Rumi Darwaza
Rumi Darwaza.title: Rumi Darwaza
Rumi Darwaza.description: The Rumi Darwaza (sometimes known as the Turkish Gate), in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, is a gateway which was built by Nawab Asaf-Ud-Daula in 1784. It is an example of Awadhi architecture.
Rumi Darwaza.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Sachiya Mata Temple.name: Sachiya Mata Temple
Sachiya Mata Temple.title: Sachiya Mata Temple
Sachiya Mata Temple.description: The Sachchiya Mata Temple is located in Osian, near Jodhpur city in the Indian state of Rajasthan. The goddess Sachiya (also spelled as Sachayay Mata and Sachchiyay Mata, Hindi: सच्चियाय माता/सच्चिया माता) is worshipped by many castes and communities living in Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and North India.
Sachiya Mata Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

San Thome Basilica.name: San Thome Basilica
San Thome Basilica.title: St. Thomas Cathedral Basilica, Chennai

Sanasar.name: Sanasar
Sanasar.title: Sanasar
Sanasar.description: Sanasar is a tourist destination and the name given to the two small villages of Sana and Sar in Ramban District, Jammu and Kashmir, India. Named after small local lakes, Sana and Sar are located 20 kilometres (12 mi) west of Patnitop, Ramban district on the national highway 1A.

Sarangapani Temple.name: Sarangapani Temple
Sarangapani Temple.title: Sarangapani Temple
Sarangapani Temple.description: The Sharngapani Temple, also known as Thirukudanthai or Kumbakonam koyil, is a Hindu temple dedicated to Vishnu, located in Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu, India. It is one of the Divya Desams, the 108 temples of Vishnu revered in Nalayira Divya Prabandham by the 12 poet-saints, or Alvars.
Sarangapani Temple.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Saraswathi Mahal Library.name: Saraswathi Mahal Library
Saraswathi Mahal Library.title: Saraswathi Mahal Library
Saraswathi Mahal Library.description: Saraswathi Mahal Library, also called Thanjavur Maharaja Serfoji's Saraswathi Mahal Library is a library located in Thanjavur (Tanjore), Tamil Nadu, India. It is one of the oldest subsisting libraries in Asia established during 16th century by the Nayak kings of Thanjavur and has on display a rare collection of Palm leaf manuscripts and paper written in Tamil and Sanskrit and a few other indigenous languages of india (especially southern regional languages).
Saraswathi Mahal Library.visitingInfo: Check the venue’s official opening, darshan and event schedule before travelling.

Sariska Tiger Reserve.name: Sariska Tiger Reserve
Sariska Tiger Reserve.title: Sariska Tiger Reserve
Sariska Tiger Reserve.description: Sariska Tiger Reserve is a tiger reserve in Alwar district of Rajasthan, India. It stretches over 1,203.34 km2 (464.61 sq mi) including a core area of 881 km2 (340 sq mi) and a buffer zone 322.23 km2 (124.41 sq mi).

Sarnath Museum.name: Sarnath Museum
Sarnath Museum.title: Sarnath Museum

Solang Valley.name: Solang Valley
Solang Valley.title: Solang Valley
Solang Valley.description: Solang Valley derives its name from a combination of the words Solang (Nearby village) and Nallah (water stream). It is a side valley at the top of the Kullu Valley in Himachal Pradesh, India 14 km northwest of the resort town Manali on the way to Rohtang Pass, and is known for its summer and winter sports conditions.

Sri Aurobindo Ashram.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram

Sri Ramana Ashram.name: Sri Ramana Ashram
Sri Ramana Ashram.title: Sri Ramana Ashram
Sri Ramana Ashram.description: Sri Ramana Ashram, also known as Sri Ramanasramam, is a historic ashram (spiritual hermitage and community) and international organisation located at the base of the sacred Arunachala Hill in Tiruvannamalai, Tamil Nadu. Subramaniya Swamy Temple, Tiruchendur.name: Subramaniya Swamy Temple, Tiruchendur
Subramaniya Swamy Temple, Tiruchendur.title: Subramaniya Swamy Temple, Tiruchendur
Subramaniya Swamy Temple, Tiruchendur.description: Subramanya Swamy Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Hindu god Murugan, located in Thoothukudi district, Tamil Nadu. It is one of the Six Abodes of Murugan (Arupadai Veedu), a set of foremost and sacred Hindu temples, dedicated to Murugan.

Surendrapuri.name: Surendrapuri
Surendrapuri.title: Surendrapuri
Surendrapuri.description: Surendrapuri is a religious tourism destination located near Hyderabad, Telangana, India in the Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district. The 17-acre religious complex includes the Kunda Satyanarayana Kaladhamam - India's first mythological museum, Panchamukha Hanumadeeswara Devasthanam (Hindu temple), Navagraha temples, Nagakoti idol, and Surendrapuri’s iconic two-sided Panchamukha Hanuman-Shiva statue.

Thiruvalluvar Statue.name: Thiruvalluvar Statue

Thiruvalluvar Statue.description: The Thiruvalluvar Statue, or Valluvar Statue, is a 40.6-metre-tall (133 ft) stone sculpture of Tamil poet and philosopher Valluvar, known as Thiruvalluvar, the author of the Thirukkural, an ancient Tamil work on morality. It is atop a small island near the town of Kanniyakumari on the southernmost point of the Indian peninsula in the state of Tamil Nadu, India, where the Bay of Bengal, the Arabian Sea and the Indian Ocean meet.

Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace.name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace

Tomb of I'timad-ud-Daulah.name: Tomb of I'timad-ud-Daulah

Tomb of Salim Chishti.name: Tomb of Salim Chishti
Tomb of Salim Chishti.title: Tomb of Salim Chishti
Tomb of Salim Chishti.description: The Tomb of Salim Chishti is a mausoleum locating within the quadrangle of the Jama Masjid in Fatehpur Sikri, Uttar Pradesh, India. It enshrines the burial place of the Sufi saint Salim Chisti (1478 – 1572), a descendant of Baba Farid, and who lived in a cavern on the ridge at Sikri.

Triveni Sangam.name: Triveni Sangam
Triveni Sangam.title: Triveni Sangam
Triveni Sangam.description: In Hindu tradition, Triveni Sangam is a confluence (Sanskrit: sangama) of three rivers that is a sacred place, with a bath there said to flush away all of one's sins and free one from the cycle of rebirth. The best-known of these confluences is the Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj which is the site of Kumbh Mela.

Ucchi Pillayar Temple.name: Ucchi Pillayar Temple
Ucchi Pillayar Temple.title: Ucchi Pillayar Temple, Rockfort
Ucchi Pillayar Temple.description: The Ucchi Pillayar Temple is a 7th-century-CE Hindu temple, one dedicated to Ganesha located a top of Rock Fort, Trichy, Tamil Nadu, India. According to legend, this rock is the place where Ganesha ran from King Vibishana, after establishing the Ranganathaswamy deity in Srirangam.

Udupi Sri Krishna Matha.description: Udupi Shri Krishna Temple is a well-known historic Hindu temple dedicated to Krishna and Dvaita Matha, located in the city of Udupi in Karnataka, India. The Matha area resembles a living ashram, a holy place for daily devotion and living.

Vadakkunnathan Temple.title: Vadakkunnathan Temple

Vaishno Devi Temple.title: Vaishno Devi Temple
Vaishno Devi Temple.description: The Vaishno Devi Temple, also known as the Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Temple and Vaishno Devi Bhavan, is a Hindu temple in Katra, Reasi district, Jammu and Kashmir. Dedicated to Vaishno Devi, a manifestation of goddesses Mahakali, Mahalakshmi, and Mahasarasvati, it is on Trikuta mountain at an elevation of 5,200 feet (1,500 meters).

Vaitheeswaran Koil.name: Vaitheeswaran Koil
Vaitheeswaran Koil.title: Vaitheeswaran Koil
Vaitheeswaran Koil.description: Vaitheeswaran Koil is a Hindu temple dedicated to the Shiva, located in a small town Vaitheeswarankoil near Mayiladuthurai, Mayiladuthurai district the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. Vellore Fort.title: Vellore Fort

Vembanad.title: Vembanad

Venkateswara Temple, Tirumala.name: Venkateswara Temple, Tirumala
Venkateswara Temple, Tirumala.title: Venkateswara Temple, Tirumala
Venkateswara Temple, Tirumala.description: The Venkateswara Swami Temple—also known as Tirumala Temple, Tirupati Temple and Tirupati Balaji Temple—is a Hindu temple located in the hills of Tirumala, within Tirupati Urban Mandal, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, India. The temple is dedicated to Venkateswara, a form of Vishnu, who is believed to have appeared on earth to save mankind from trials and troubles of Kali Yuga.

Vijay Stambha.name: Vijay Stambha
Vijay Stambha.title: Vijaya Stambha
Vijay Stambha.description: The Vijaya Stambha is a Rajput victory monument located within Chittor Fort in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, India. The tower was constructed by the Hindu Rajput king Rana Kumbha of Mewar in 1448 CE to commemorate his victory over the army of Sultanate of Malwa led by Mahmud Khilji in the Battle of Sarangpur.

Virasat-e-Khalsa.name: Virasat-e-Khalsa
Virasat-e-Khalsa.title: Virasat-e-Khalsa
Virasat-e-Khalsa.description: Virasat-e-Khalsa, also known as the Khalsa Heritage Complex, is a mega-museum complex of Sikhism, located in the town of Anandpur Sahib, and is close to the Takht Kesgarh Sahib, located in the state of Punjab, India. The museum celebrates 500 years of Sikh history and the 300th anniversary of the birth of Khalsa, based on the scriptures written by the tenth and last of Sikhism's gurus, Guru Gobind Singh.
